evidence: Stepping into the heart of Van Phuc Ward, nestled within the bustling Ha Dong District, one is greeted by the vibrant energy of modern flat knitting machines. These machines stand as a testament to the enduring legacy of silk weaving, a tradition that traces back over a millennium to the time when Thanh Hoang A La Thi Nuong first imparted the art of weaving to her community.

Their most striking feature is the slider assembly, which houses thousands of tiny needles that glide swiftly across the machine, both horizontally and vertically, producing intricate patterns with breathtaking speed. These machines are the centerpiece of the brightly lit textile workshops, where they stand proudly amidst neatly stacked rustic yarn spools, adding a touch of modernity to the age-old craft.
